scenario.brief: We have given an advisor 0.5% for two years. I want it written down what we are asking of him and what he thinks he signed up for, because the last advisor we had produced nothing and nobody could say what we had expected.
scenario.theDecision: The company wants warm introductions to three named banks. The advisor thinks he was brought in for strategy sessions and has no relationship at two of the three. A right answer surfaces that the expected deliverable does not exist on his side, before the equity vests, and says which of the three he can actually do.
